# Pinned upstream license evidence

These texts fill repository-level license/notice omissions in six pinned Cargo crate archives and three NuGet packages. `index.json` records each package version, exact upstream VCS commit, license identity, URL and text SHA-256. Packaging verifies those fields against restored crate/NuGet repository metadata and includes the unchanged text in the candidate notices. A NuGet SPDX expression or license URL alone is not treated as the redistributed license text.

The objc2 text is its upstream licensing statement, including its SDK-derived-code discussion; it is retained verbatim rather than replaced with a generic license template. Final publication/source/license review remains in the release ledger.
